dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture (vertex-disjoint paths, stability number two)
dossier_meta.statement_text: We suspect the $k$ vertex-disjoint paths problem might be NP-complete for digraphs with stability number two.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors discuss whether their polynomial-time result for semicomplete digraphs (Theorem 1.2) can be extended to digraphs with bounded stability number. The edge-disjoint version is known to be polynomial-time solvable in this setting, but the vertex-disjoint version remains out of reach. The authors remark that they suspect NP-completeness already at stability number two.
